email.subject: Breakwater Pros: a couple of quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I took a look at Breakwater Pros Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call, so anyone searching on their phone can't reach you with one tap, and there's no booking link, meaning interested people have to email or call just to try signing up for a class.

The site also doesn't list your hours, and the page title doesn't mention fitness or Harbor Falls, which hurts how you show up in local search.

I fix issues like these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change, no pressure either way.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
